The clinic

Batis Dental Studio is a family and cosmetic dental clinic in Iloilo City, for people who want careful, honest dentistry without the fear that usually comes with it.

"Batis" means a spring — clear, calm, restoring — and that's the clinic we set out to run. Bright rooms, unhurried appointments, and dentists who explain what they see and why, so you're never agreeing to something you don't understand.

We look after whole families: a child's first check-up, a teenager's braces, an adult's crown, a grandparent's dentures. Preventive care first, so the big, expensive problems mostly never happen.

Our care

Dentistry for the whole family

Everything from a routine clean to a full smile makeover, under one calm roof.

Check-ups & cleaning

Routine exams, professional cleaning and preventive care that catches problems while they're small.

Cosmetic & whitening

Whitening, veneers and bonding to brighten and reshape a smile you're happy to show.

Braces & aligners

Traditional braces and clear aligners for children, teens and adults, with the plan explained up front.

Restorations

Fillings, crowns, bridges, dentures and implants to rebuild teeth that are worn, broken or missing.

Children's dentistry

Short, gentle, positive first visits that keep the dentist a calm place as your child grows.

Urgent relief

Toothache, a lost filling or a knock — message us and we'll fit in urgent care as soon as we can.

Treatment always starts with an assessment and a clear explanation of your options and their upkeep.

Inside Batis

A look around

Good to know

Your questions

Are your dentists licensed? +
Yes. Every dentist at Batis is PRC-licensed and a member of the Philippine Dental Association. Credentials are displayed in the clinic and we're happy to answer any question about them.
How often should I have a check-up? +
For most healthy adults, a check-up and clean every six months keeps problems small and cheap to fix. We'll advise a schedule that fits your mouth after your first visit.
I'm nervous about the dentist. Can you help? +
Very much so. Tell us at booking. We explain everything before we do it, work at your pace, and never rush or guilt you. Many of our regulars first came in anxious.
Do you treat children? +
We do. We see children for gentle check-ups, cleans and preventive care, and keep first visits short and positive so the dentist stays a calm place for them.
Do you offer braces or clear aligners? +
Yes — both traditional braces and clear aligners. Treatment starts with an assessment and a clear explanation of options, timeline and care before anything begins.
What should I bring to my first visit? +
Just yourself and any past dental records or X-rays if you have them. We'll take a full history, examine gently and talk through findings before planning any treatment.
How do I book? +
Book by Messenger or phone. Let us know if it's a routine visit or something that's bothering you, and whether it's for an adult or a child, so we can set aside the right time.
